description: Single-tag (not cluster-level) view: per tag, game count, median complexity, median estimated sales, median positive review percentage, median price.
signature: def build_tag_summary(frame: pd.DataFrame, tags: pd.DataFrame, params: AnalysisParams) -> pd.DataFrame
docstring:
Compute per-tag summary statistics.

Args:
    frame: The full enriched frame.
    tags: The run's tag rows (appid, tag, votes, rank), unfiltered by cluster membership -- this is deliberately a per-tag, not per-cluster, view, per the module's design note 'Single-tag views are still produced for the tag summary table, but the opportunity matrix is cluster-level'.
    params: AnalysisParams.min_tag_votes (applied here too, independently of any clustering-stage filtering).

Returns:
    A DataFrame with one row per distinct tag (post min_tag_votes filtering), columns: tag, n_games, median_complexity_score, median_estimated_sales_mid, median_review_positive_pct, median_price_usd.
preconditions: tags and frame share the same run's appid space
postconditions: Every row has n_games >= 1 (a tag with zero surviving games after filtering does not appear)
median_review_positive_pct is in [0, 1] or NaN, never a raw percentage

edge_cases.input: A tag applied to only one game
edge_cases.expected_behavior: n_games=1; every median simply equals that one game's value

edge_cases.input: A tag whose games are all free-to-play (median_estimated_sales_mid well-defined but revenue-derived medians would be all-NaN)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: median_estimated_sales_mid still computed normally (estimated_sales_mid is defined even for F2P games, per FORMULATION.md section 2 -- only revenue is NULL for F2P, not sales); this function does not include a revenue column at all, avoiding the all-NaN issue entirely

edge_cases.input: min_tag_votes filters out every tag (degenerate config)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty DataFrame with the documented columns

unit_tests.name: test_single_game_tag_medians_equal_that_game
unit_tests.description: A tag on exactly one game has every median equal to that game's own values.
unit_tests.expected: medians match the single game's values

unit_tests.name: test_review_pct_in_ratio_range
unit_tests.description: median_review_positive_pct is always in [0,1] for a fixture with known review percentages.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_after_min_votes_filter
unit_tests.description: A min_tag_votes higher than any tag's vote count returns an empty frame.
